name: Imperia (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Imperia (a white cross on red and a tree on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Imperia, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Imperia arms — white cross on red and a tree on white, crowned, within branches
